name: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Limited
summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and marketing of enzymes and probiotics in India, Europe, the United States, Asia, and internationally. The company offers serratiopeptidase, fungal lactase, peptizyme SP, nattokinase, fungal lipase, alpha galactosidase, saccharomyces boulardii, hemicellulose, papain, bromelain, fungal proteases, and bacterial alpha amylase. It also provides probiotics for human and animal nutrition.
